0022600088.text: Both the Chicago Bulls and Toronto Raptors open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Bulls a 25% chance to win. Chicago's Nic Claxton is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and is a game-time decision. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Chucky Hepburn, Immanuel Quickley, Jakob Poeltl, Kawhi Leonard, Nate Bittle, RJ Barrett and Scottie Barnes are all day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Bulls lost all three of their 2025-26 meetings with the Raptors, most recently 139-109 in Chicago on March 18, 2026.
